objective: Implement the deterministic Demo / Paper Trading Engine that continuously simulates governed strategy decisions without broker/exchange routing, preserves point-in-time state and produces auditable decision/fill/outcome events for later P18 learning workstreams.
scope: Consume trusted point-in-time market observations and canonical strategy/model identities
Run deterministic paper sessions with monotonic event sequence and event-time enforcement
Require an injected paper execution simulator with no production execution default
Maintain deterministic cash, positions, marks, equity and pending simulated decisions
Support deterministic session snapshots and resume identity
Reject duplicate events, future information, unknown fills, duplicate fills and overfills
Emit auditable paper decision/fill/outcome records for P18-B journal consumption
Keep Demo/Paper mode isolated from broker/exchange order routing
out_of_scope: Broker/exchange connectivity or live order execution
dependencies: Owner P18 phase authorization GRANTED / CONSUMED
tests: Same inputs produce identical paper session state identity
Duplicate or decreasing event sequence/time fails closed
Unknown or duplicate simulated fill fails closed
Overfill and asset/price-scale mismatch fail closed
Multi-asset paper equity accounting is deterministic
No broker/exchange routing authority is emitted
No Live/Auto or automatic-promotion authority is emitted
P18-A evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P18-A learning/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P17 remains canonical complete and P18-B remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: Deterministic Demo / Paper Trading Engine implemented
Point-in-time event and state invariants enforced
Injected paper execution simulator required with no production routing default
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
